title: Opening, closing and duplicating in Music and Classes never acts on a stale or hidden request
acceptance: openPlaylist ignores a late reply for a playlist no longer shown and clears the songs on Back, so Start class never creates class B with A's songs (lane-B repro passes).
Duplicate runs through useAsyncAction: it shows pending state and an error message, and a repeat tap does not make a second copy (lane-B repro passes).
Closing the playlist or likes dialog during Creating does not navigate the instructor into the new class later; the recommended behavior is to skip navigation and show a toast.
TrackPreview Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record and catches failures; a new test covers the return record. The e2e smoke is unchanged.

The resolution as built at d189f58, kept for when the ticket closes: Built in batch #808 on branch fix/rf-111-stale-hidden-requests. (1) The Music saved-playlist dialog's openPlaylist keeps a request id: a reply, error or finally for a playlist no longer shown is ignored, and Back bumps the id and clears the songs and the loading state, so Start class can no longer create class B with A's songs or enable Start on A's songs under B's heading. (2) Classes › Recents row menu Duplicate runs through one useAsyncAction for the whole list: while a copy runs the menu item reads 'Duplicating…', is named 'Duplicating… — <title>' so its accessible name carries the visible text (WCAG 2.5.3, fix round 1), and is disabled, a repeat tap is a no-op, and a failure reaches the Dashboard error line (ClassesHome gained an onError prop). useAsyncAction now reports through errMessage, so a blank or non-Error failure shows 'Something went wrong.' instead of nothing. (3) The owner's call quoted in #808: closing the playlist dialog or the likes 'Create a class' sheet (SongPickCreateDialog, which replaced the audit's LikesBrowserDialog) during Creating skips the navigation into the new class and shows a toast, 'Class created: <title>', in a bottom role=status region that clears after 6 s. Once the import ends, that walk-away path reads the class's run payload (or its track count when it cannot run) and updates its card in place, so Recents and Jump back in show its songs and length without opening it or reloading (fix round 1); if the instructor opened that class in the builder meanwhile, it reloads the builder silently instead, which also syncs the card, so the open builder shows the imported songs (fix round 2). A dialog left open still opens the class as before; the import result banner is unchanged. (4) TrackPreview takes returnTo {userId, classId}; its Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record before the provider redirect, connection-return accepts 'builder' only with a classId, and the OAuth return reopens that class in the builder. The interrupted-preview Reconnect button catches a failed start silently (no new copy), leaving the button to try again; the Spotify playback-scope Reconnect keeps its existing error line. The e2e smoke is unchanged. Fix round 3, outside batch #808 on the owner's word recorded there ("Let's give RF-111 another fix round"), for the significant finding from the correctness review of d189f58. refreshClassCard in Dashboard.tsx: (1) the silent loadDetail(classId, { silent: true, owner }) now returns only when it resolves a payload or null; when it resolves undefined (the read was dropped, for example the builder was closed or switched mid-read) it falls through to the card-only refresh; (2) on the card-only path, when no builder is open (detailWorkspace) or suspended by Live (suspendedWorkspace) and the cached builder detail is this class (a new detailClassId ref mirrors detail.classId each render), it dispatches the file's existing reset with ++detailRequestId.current before the card reads, so Back or Forward to /classes/:id refetches through restoreClass instead of RF-195's no-refetch restore. The Live guard is a judgment call beyond the brief: exitLive already reloads a suspended builder silently, and resetting it there would show a loading skeleton, or leave one if that reload failed. resolution: Built in batch #808 on branch fix/rf-111-stale-hidden-requests, with a third fix round outside the batch on the owner's word recorded on #808. (1) The Music saved-playlist dialog's openPlaylist keeps a request id: a reply, error or finally for a playlist no longer shown is ignored, and Back bumps the id and clears the songs and the loading state, so Start class can no longer create class B with A's songs or enable Start on A's songs under B's heading. (2) Classes › Recents row menu Duplicate runs through one useAsyncAction for the whole list: while a copy runs the menu item reads 'Duplicating…', is named 'Duplicating… — <title>' so its accessible name carries the visible text (WCAG 2.5.3, fix round 1), and is disabled, a repeat tap is a no-op, and a failure reaches the Dashboard error line (ClassesHome gained an onError prop). useAsyncAction now reports through errMessage, so a blank or non-Error failure shows 'Something went wrong.' instead of nothing. (3) The owner's call quoted in #808: closing the playlist dialog or the likes 'Create a class' sheet (SongPickCreateDialog, which replaced the audit's LikesBrowserDialog) during Creating skips the navigation into the new class and shows a toast, 'Class created: <title>', in a bottom role=status region that clears after 6 s. Once the import ends, that walk-away path reads the class's run payload (or its track count when it cannot run) and updates its card in place, so Recents and Jump back in show its songs and length without opening it or reloading (fix round 1); if the instructor opened that class in the builder meanwhile, it reloads the builder silently instead, which also syncs the card, so the open builder shows the imported songs (fix round 2). If that silent reload is dropped because the instructor closed or switched the builder mid-read, it updates the card instead, so the card never stays at 0 tracks · 0:00; and when no builder is open or held by Live but the Dashboard still caches that class's builder (opened from Recents, then left by the top nav), it drops that cache, so browser Back or Forward to /classes/:id refetches the class instead of RF-195's no-refetch restore showing it as it was before the import (fix round 3). Another class's cached builder and an open builder are never touched. A dialog left open still opens the class as before; the import result banner is unchanged. (4) TrackPreview takes returnTo {userId, classId}; its Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record before the provider redirect, connection-return accepts 'builder' only with a classId, and the OAuth return reopens that class in the builder. The interrupted-preview Reconnect button catches a failed start silently (no new copy), leaving the button to try again; the Spotify playback-scope Reconnect keeps its existing error line. The e2e smoke is unchanged.
